annualConvention: An annual display uses the status in force by the end of that year. Dates below preserve the event's actual precision; 1262–1263 is an explicitly transitional display, not a reconstructed internal partition.
geometryConvention: Natural Earth 1:10m modern Iceland land is an island display mask. It is not a reconstruction of medieval shorelines, settlement extent, maritime limits or internal administration. The excision rectangle isolates Iceland from all other land in the supplied Natural Earth source, and removes upstream coastal misalignment fragments before replacement.
before930: Remove upstream political fills inside the excision envelope and draw no replacement state fill. This makes no claim that Iceland was uninhabited or that settlements formed one sovereign state.

sources.title: The Department of State to the British Embassy
sources.institution: US Department of State, FRUS 1944, vol. III, document 907
sources.supports: Independent state since 1918; the 1941 defence agreement explicitly respected Icelandic independence and sovereignty.
